name: Black Orcs

specialRules.name: Animosity
specialRules.text: Standard rules for Animosity (Orc Mob Rules, Mordheim Annual 2002).

specialRules.name: Let the goons do the work
specialRules.text: Black Orcs do not ride mounts of any kind. Only normal Orcs may ride a boar or other mount.

specialRules.name: Da Boss is Dead!
specialRules.text: If the Boss is killed a Black Orc always assumes leadership of the warband before any other type, regardless of experience; the replacement automatically acquires the 'Oi Behave!' skill.

equipmentLists.name: Henchman equipment list
equipmentLists.usedBy: Young'uns, Orc Boyz, Orc Shootaz, Orc Nuttaz

specialRules.name: Leader
specialRules.text: Any warrior within 6" of the Boss may use his Leadership when taking Leadership tests.

specialRules.name: Black Orc
specialRules.text: Starts with a natural 6+ armour save (natural 12 on the d12), which can be combined with other equipment.

specialRules.name: Oi Behave!
specialRules.text: If a Henchman fails his Animosity test within 6" of the Boss, the Boss may slap him: automatic hit at a Strength the player chooses. If the Henchman is still on his feet he adds the slap's Strength to his Animosity effect roll.

specialRules.name: Black Orc
specialRules.text: Starts with a 6+ armour save (natural 12 on the d12), which can be improved by equipment.

fighters.name: Young'un

specialRules.name: Black Orc Blood
specialRules.text: One Young'un may be upgraded to a Black Orc Young'un for 10gc, allowing him to take the 'Proven Warrior' skill and become a full Black Orc warrior.

fighters.notes: Hero. Uses the Henchman equipment list. Limit 0-2 Young'uns.

specialRules.name: Animosity
specialRules.text: At the start of every turn must take a Ld test for Animosity (Mordheim Annual 2002 rules).

fighters.name: Orc Shoota

specialRules.name: Animosity
specialRules.text: At the start of every turn must take a Ld test for Animosity (Mordheim Annual 2002 rules).

specialRules.name: Uncommon
specialRules.text: May not hire more Shootaz than Boyz; if Shootaz outnumber Boyz the next hire must be a Boy.

fighters.notes: Max = number of Orc Boyz in the warband.

fighters.name: Orc Nutta

specialRules.name: Unstable
specialRules.text: Not subject to Animosity.

specialRules.name: Crazy
specialRules.text: Always passes Leadership-based tests; may never learn Academic skills.

specialRules.name: Savage
specialRules.text: Must always run or charge maximum distance towards the nearest visible enemy (friendly models do not block line of sight); fights with an extra attack (not on profile, not counted for racial maximum). Never uses armour or ranged weapons. May never be Leader or use his Ld for rout tests unless the only models left.

fighters.notes: Cannot use armour or missile weapons despite the Henchman list.

fighters.name: Troll
fixedEquipment: None (never given weapons or armour; may carry a big club)

specialRules.name: Fear
specialRules.text: Causes fear.

specialRules.name: Stupidity
specialRules.text: Subject to stupidity.

specialRules.name: Large Target
specialRules.text: Large target for shooting.

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.text: When wounded roll a D12; on 7+ the wound is ignored. Not vs fire or fire-based magic. Never rolls for injury after battle unless taken out by fire, then as a normal Henchman.

specialRules.name: Dumb Monster
specialRules.text: Never learns skills or gains experience.

specialRules.name: Always Hungry
specialRules.text: Upkeep 20gc after every game. If unpaid the Boss may count it as 2 members so it costs only 5gc, reducing max warband size to 11.

specialRules.name: Vomit Attack
specialRules.text: Instead of normal attacks, a single automatic hit at Strength 5 ignoring armour saves.

conversionNotes: Black Orc natural 6+ armour save recorded as natural 12 (6+ -> 12 rule); flagged for a human to confirm the intended d12 save.
'Da Boss is Dead' warband rule and Oi Behave! skill reference kept as printed.
Young'un is a hero (listed under Heroes) but uses the Henchman equipment list; fixed at 0-2, 25gc, 0 exp.
Two-handed weapon is 'Boyz and Nuttaz only' and Crossbow 'Shootaz only' per footnotes (footnote placement under the item). Nuttaz may not use armour or ranged weapons per Savage.
Orc Shootaz max (as many as Boyz) recorded as null; see notes.
Black Orc Special Skills ('Proven Warrior', 'Ard Ead', 'Waaagh!', 'Ere we go!', 'Da cunnin plan', 'Eadbasher) are not transcribed as fighter data; 'Ard Ead' 3+/2+ saves would convert to 5+/3+.
Max profile (not in schema): Black Orc M4 WS7 BS6 S5 T6 W3 I5 A4 Ld9; Orc M4 WS6 BS6 S4 T5 W3 I5 A4 Ld9.
Troll upkeep 20gc kept in rule text.
